text:
Priya: Quick thread 52 planning: regional A/B + staged ramp for the EU+APAC model swap. Need an experiment contract and auto-fallback rules. Thoughts?
Alex: Let's split into two parallel flows: A/B for quality/engagement metrics, canary for infra/cost. Keep them separate to avoid signal contamination.
Jordan: Agree. A/B buckets must be sticky by user-id and have deterministic hashing. No session-level bucketing for A/B.
Meena: Minimum sample sizes? For core engagement metric (reply_rate) we should require at least 10k impressions per arm or 7 days, whichever is first.
Rachael: Also require pre-specified primary metric and one safety metric (latency or error). Stop rules: if safety metric breach occurs, pause A/B immediately.
Luis: Safety thresholds: error_rate >=1% absolute OR p99 latency delta >250ms for 10m. If triggered -> auto-fallback to baseline and page SRE.
Samir: Implement a kill-switch feature-flag with three modes: off (baseline), canary (traffic slice), experiment (A/B). Flag flips log user and approver. RBAC = Product+SRE.
Elena: CS note: enterprise customers must be opt-out by tenant id. Provide a per-tenant exclusion list that is respected by both canary and A/B flows.
Priya: Good. For the A/B analysis plan: use uplift test with Bayesian posterior to avoid multiple comparisons issues. Predefine minimum detectable effect = 2% relative on reply_rate.
Alex: Also bake a short-term vs long-term metric plan. Short-term is reply_rate, long-term retention and cost per session. If short-term looks good but long-term cost degrades, we should auto-hold.
Jordan: Shadowing: route 100% of requests as pass-through to baseline in parallel (no impact) for first 48h to collect output diffs and semantic drift metrics.
Rachael: Quality checks: sample 1k prompts/day and run embedding-similarity + hallucination detectors. If embedding-similarity drops by >0.05 or hallucination rate up >1% -> abort.
Luis: Cost control: measure tokens/response and model compute seconds. Alert if cost_per_session > baseline * 1.4 over rolling 2h window. Auto-fallback if both cost and latency exceed thresholds.
Samir: Runbook steps on fallback: 1) auto-fallback runs 2) create incident with prefilled template 3) ops can flip flag to baseline 4) postmortem template created. I'll draft CLI commands.
Meena: Dashboard ownership: Product owns experiment metrics and quality panels; SRE owns infra and cost. We need a combined "experiment health" boolean visible to oncall.
Priya: Define composite signal: PASS if (safety_ok AND quality_ok AND cost_ok AND sample_size_met). Otherwise HOLD.
Alex: Metric windows: use rolling 5m for infra, daily for quality, and 24h aggregation for A/B significance checks.
Jordan: Design the traffic slices: day1 = 0.5% sample in EU + 0.2% in APAC for 2h. Day2 = 5% for 6h. Day3 = 20% then ramp to 100% if signals green.
Elena: We should notify customers in the test cohort at least 48h before if they have opt-in privileges. Provide an easy opt-out link.
Rachael: Legal/Compliance: for private installs, we cannot shadow or flip flags without explicit customer consent. Need contract flag.
Priya: Logging: every decision must be annotated with reason and actor. Include experiment_id, variant, sample_id in logs for traceability.
Samir: CLI example (draft): `rw flag set model_experiment --mode experiment --ttl 60m --experiment-id exp-202405` plus `rw flag set model_experiment --dry-run` for notify-only.
Luis: Telemetry: tag all spans with model_version and experiment_id. Add cost burn metric per model per-tenant.
Alex: Statistical checks: require posterior probability >95% that treatment > baseline for primary metric before we call it better. Also require no safety breaches in the same window.
Jordan: For rollout automation, use a staged-orchestrator job that watches composite signal and advances or rolls back. Keep a manual override path.
Meena: Rehearsal: propose a dry-run next Wed where we flip flags in staging, run the dry-run path, and validate alerts. SRE + Product + CS oncall attend.
Elena: I'll coordinate CS and send out a prep doc with customer-facing wording.
Rachael: I'll write the experiment contract template and the precise thresholds.
Priya: Action items: Samir -> runbook + CLI by EOD Fri; Luis -> telemetry + cost alerts by Tue; Rachael -> experiment contract + thresholds by Tue; Alex -> orchestrator job skeleton; Meena -> schedule dry-run.
SRE-Bot: deploybot: experiment-orchestrator v1.3 deployed to staging at 2024-06-10T14:12Z (healthchecks pending).
Meena: Thanks. If no blockers I'll convert this into the product rollout card and request the experiment id. :thumbsup:
